prompt: Diagnose the latency incident using the files in incident/. Identify the cause or causes, recommend the safest first action, and write diagnosis.md. Make the reasoning auditable enough that another engineer can challenge it.

assertions.description: Diagnosis captures the interacting load, fan-out, saturation, and retry loop
Diagnosis cites temporal and metric evidence that distinguishes candidates
Earlier deployment is downgraded using observed timing
First mitigation is reversible and attacks the observed feedback loop
Reasoning exposes lens choice, candidates, evidence, rejection, and falsifier
